scope: Direct skin-owned TMDb Helper 6.21.5 contract review and Favourites opt-in correction; source protocol check with mocked Kodi API, no native or online data claim.

sources.finding: Manifest identifies the checked upstream version as 6.21.5.
The skin service opt-in is still TMDbHelper.Service.
The receiving container selector remains Skin.String(TMDbHelper.MonitorContainer).
Selector is converted to an integer; receiver must be visible; the active-window control receives the ListItem through addItem. Exit sends an empty ListItem.
Container finalisation delivers the populated ListItem to that control.
Provider metadata maps the icon field to the provider logo and uses the provider property prefix.
Property enumeration begins at one and materialises indexed provider property names.
WINDOW_XML_MEDIA omits MyFavourites.xml; non-empty WidgetContainer string enables polling. Listitem branch precedes clear branch.
widget_id converts property to int; container(0) returns Container. and preserves the native default view.
WindowChecker.get_window_property defaults to string; get_property accepts explicit int conversion. String zero opts in while integer zero selects default container.

kodi_property_case_source.finding: ListItem properties use CaseInsensitiveCompare. The skin's Provider.N.Icon casing and the producer's provider.N.icon casing are compatible.

checked_contracts.assessment: Name retained; not a new native service-start test.
Current upstream getter and integer conversion accept the same selector.

checked_contracts.skin: List 99950, 1 by 1 pixels, off-screen, with no explicit false visibility
checked_contracts.assessment: XML supplies the expected Python-populated list type. Runtime visibility/delivery remains untested here.

checked_contracts.skin: MyVideoNav.xml and MyFavourites.xml include the receiver when the addon is enabled.
checked_contracts.assessment: MyVideoNav.xml matches the upstream media-window list; MyFavourites.xml does not. Four skin lifecycle actions now explicitly opt Favourites in and clean up. Original upstream-code model passes for local/global mode; native lifecycle not tested.
One-based icon fields and case-insensitive property lookup agree with producer.

checked_contracts.skin: Empty icon properties hide their image controls.
checked_contracts.assessment: Upstream exit path sends an empty item. Actual transitions and outstanding jobs were not tested.

conclusion: Service/container/icon names remain supported. Current upstream excludes MyFavourites.xml from automatic media-window monitoring. Skin now opts its default container into monitoring via WidgetContainer=0 and clears local/Home properties on unload; original upstream code confirms both container modes in the bounded source model. Native verification remains pending.
limits: No native run of 6.21.5 or verification of its dependencies performed.
No addon upgraded, copied or modified for this review.
Online watch-provider availability, country/settings, selection/dialog transitions and first installation remain outside this source proof.
Off-screen XML placement alone does not prove actual native Control.IsVisible or renderer behaviour.
No guarantee for unpublished future changes.
New onload/onunload builtin dispatch and timing are source-model verified only; visible Kodi test remains open.
